projects.title: DevOps Launchpad — Docker & CI/CD
projects.bodyText:
- Built a **Node.js dashboard** displaying live application health, uptime, and release information.
- Containerized the app with **Docker**, a non-root user, and automated health checks.
- Automated **six integration tests**, Docker image builds, and container verification using **GitHub Actions**.
- Deployed on **Render** with automatic deployment after CI checks pass.
- Verified the delivery flow by pushing a code change and confirming it appeared on the live site.

projects.title: Highly Available AWS VPC & ALB Architecture
projects.bodyText:
- Designed a highly available AWS web architecture across multiple Availability Zones.
- Configured a custom **VPC**, public subnets, route tables, Internet Gateway, and security groups.
- Deployed **Amazon EC2** web servers behind an **Application Load Balancer (ALB)** for traffic distribution and high availability.
- Integrated **Amazon S3** for web assets, backups, and ALB access logs.
- Implemented **IAM roles** and least-privilege access for secure AWS resource communication.
